note: Swallowed products act systemically: all systemic groups plus mouth and throat (A01 R02); oral carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (S01EC) and oral contrast media (V08). Skin-acting D codes are dropped except the systemic dermatology groups; other eye/ear S codes and topical M02 C05A are dropped
Absorbed through the mouth lining into the circulation; same groups as ORAL (without contrast media) plus allergen extracts for under-the-tongue immunotherapy
Absorbed through the cheek into the circulation or acting in the mouth; same groups as ORAL (without contrast media)

Applied to the skin: dermatological D plus topical groups in other chapters (haemorrhoid and vein products C05A C05B; muscle and joint rubs M02; ectoparasiticides P03). Hormone gels (G03) and nicotine products (N07BA) on skin act systemically. Systemic codes (e.g. H02AB01 for betamethasone) are dropped
Applied to the skin; same groups as TOPICAL

Patches: systemic delivery (nitrates; clonidine; hormones; oxybutynin; anti-emetics; opioids; nicotine; dementia and Parkinson drugs; stimulants) or local action (anaesthetic and pain patches D04 M02 N01B)
Eye products: ophthalmological groups only
Ear products: otological groups only

Nasal products: local nasal groups (R01A) plus drugs given by nasal spray for systemic action (triptans and other N drugs; desmopressin; calcitonin; glucagon; ketorolac; naloxone; epinephrine; vitamin B12; testosterone; metoclopramide)

Inhaled products: airway groups R03A R03B R05 R07 plus inhaled anti-infectives; inhaled insulin; inhaled prostacyclins; inhaled anaesthetics; inhaled levodopa and loxapine; medical gases; inhaled antidotes (V03AB); inhaled lung-scan agents (V09E)
Dental products: stomatological group A01 (fluorides; antiseptics; local antibiotics; epinephrine as local vasoconstrictor); local anaesthetics; mouth-and-throat antiseptics (R02AA)

Injected into a vein: systemic groups only; no D; no topical M02 C05A; no local mouth/gut groups A01 A06 A07. Exceptions kept because these drugs are given IV: sclerosants (C05BB); sildenafil for pulmonary hypertension (G04BE); IV acetazolamide (S01EC); IV eye diagnostics and photodynamic therapy (S01JA S01LA)
Injected into muscle: same systemic groups as INTRAVENOUS

Injected under the skin: same systemic groups as INTRAVENOUS plus injected skin biologics (D11AH) and other drugs given by subcutaneous injection or implant (methylnaltrexone A06AH; afamelanotide D02BB; deoxycholic acid D11AX)
Local anaesthetic injected into tissue; C01CA keeps epinephrine added as a vasoconstrictor; M01A keeps an NSAID co-instilled with a local anaesthetic
Nerve block: local anaesthetics and added epinephrine
Epidural injection: local anaesthetics; opioids; clonidine; added epinephrine
Caudal block: local anaesthetics and added epinephrine
Joint injection: corticosteroids and local anaesthetics
Suppositories and enemas act locally in the bowel (A06 A07 C05A) or systemically (analgesics; anti-emetics; anticonvulsants; corticosteroids); rectal contrast media (V08)
Vaginal products: gynaecological anti-infectives; other gynaecologicals (rings; prostaglandins); vaginal hormones
